items.name: chronicle
items.title: Chronicle
items.description: A zoomable, multi-lane timeline for incidents, releases and audit trails — spans, instants, a playhead and an overview brush.

items.name: trend-chart
items.title: TrendChart
items.description: Values over time as an instrument: a live legend that reads the crosshair, drag-to-measure deltas, annotations, thresholds and linked views.

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: Audio you can see and scrub: a waveform over a native audio element, with chapters, speed, skips and an imperative handle.

items.name: plane
items.title: Plane
items.description: An infinite, zoomable surface for boards, maps and diagrams — inertia, pinch, a minimap and a camera that follows keyboard focus.

items.name: flow-graph
items.title: FlowGraph
items.description: A node-and-wire editor: drag, wire with magnetic ports or the keyboard, refuse bad connections, watch runs flow and tidy into layers.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: A hierarchy by size that you enter like a place: squarified blocks, a camera that moves inside, nested previews, heat and a path back out.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: A kanban board with lift-and-carry dragging, cards that part and fly into place, advisory limits, collapsible columns and a full keyboard path.

items.name: outliner
items.title: Outliner
items.description: A keyboard-first outline: Enter splits, Tab restructures, whole branches move and fold, and any item can be zoomed into until it becomes the title.

items.name: query-builder
items.title: QueryBuilder
items.description: Conditions that read as a sentence: typed operators per field, nested any/all groups, a plain-language reading and an evaluator for local filtering.

items.name: annotator
items.title: Annotator
items.description: Review pins on anything: drop numbered pins, discuss in threads, resolve and reopen, and find every conversation in the list beside the work.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A guided tour whose spotlight travels between real elements, follows them through scrolling and reflow, and explains each one beside it.

items.name: interview
items.title: Interview
items.description: A conversation instead of a form: one question at a time, letter keys for choices, branching, a review before sending and an honest submit.

items.name: transfer-queue
items.title: TransferQueue
items.description: Uploads you can watch and steer: a concurrency-limited queue around your own transfer function, with live speed, time left, pause, retry and cancel.

items.name: triage-deck
items.title: TriageDeck
items.description: Decisions at the speed of a gesture: fling the top card toward a decision, or use arrows and buttons — with tallies and an undo that flies the card back.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: A justified photo grid whose photos open from exactly where they sit: swipe to travel, pull down to put one back, pinch or double-tap to look closer.

items.name: folio
items.title: Folio
items.description: A long-form reading surface: sidenotes sit in the margin beside their marks and fold into the text on narrow screens, while a contents rail keeps your place.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: SplitFlap
items.description: A mechanical flip display: every character falls forward through the drum to its new value, cell after cell, and lands with a slap.

items.name: column-browser
items.title: ColumnBrowser
items.description: Miller columns: choose an item and its contents open alongside, loading on demand, until a leaf opens in a preview — a stack you push and pop on narrow screens.

items.name: log-stream
items.title: LogStream
items.description: A live log tail that renders only what is in view: it follows new lines until you scroll away, counts what you missed, and searches, filters and opens any line whole.

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A rotary control for instruments rather than forms: drag up or down, Shift for fine, arrows to step, double-click to return home — with log tapers for frequencies and times.

items.name: fader
items.title: Fader
items.description: A console fader with a live meter: drag the cap, click the track to jump, and watch the level fall away beside it with a held peak.

items.name: xypad
items.title: XYPad
items.description: Two parameters under one finger: press anywhere and the puck springs there, then sweep both at once with a trail behind it.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The primary action surface — solid, ghost and inverse, with a loading state and an arrow that leans into the hover.

items.name: mark
items.title: Mark
items.description: The diamond: a small marker for a state or position.

items.name: section-tag
items.title: SectionTag
items.description: Compact structural text with an optional diamond marker.

items.name: rule
items.title: Rule
items.description: A hairline separator with a meaningful optional label.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact, bordered label for metadata and status.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A rotating diamond with a clear loading announcement.

items.name: frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: Crop marks that frame media without competing with it.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A diamond-thumb range with an always-readable value.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small, linked explanation that works with focus and can be dismissed.

items.name: mask-line
items.title: MaskLine
items.description: The Mizu headline reveal — text rises from inside its own mask, one line at a time.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Scroll-triggered entrance with direction, distance and delay control.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: A spring-follow wrapper — the surface leans toward the cursor and settles back.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A seamless infinite ticker that pauses on hover and stands still for reduced motion.

items.name: page-wipe
items.title: PageWipe
items.description: The page transition — a full-screen sweep with a label, and an imperative API that hands you the midpoint.

items.name: presence
items.title: Presence
items.description: A keyed state enters after the previous state has made room.

items.name: tilt
items.title: Tilt
items.description: A restrained depth response to the pointer, returning cleanly to rest.

items.name: parallax
items.title: Parallax
items.description: A bounded depth cue linked to the surface's actual position in the viewport.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: ScrollProgress
items.description: A thin reading indicator driven by real document scroll progress.

items.name: specimen
items.title: Specimen
items.description: A live type tester — set text, size, weight, tracking and serif voice while the specimen redraws.

items.name: soft-type
items.title: SoftType
items.description: A variable-font engine in CSS — weight and width oscillate through the Archivo axes.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: WaveText
items.description: Kinetic text that answers the cursor — each letter lifts, scales and warms as you pass over it.

items.name: ghost-word
items.title: GhostWord
items.description: An oversized outlined word that fills with accent when hovered — built for footers and chapter markers.

items.name: pinfield
items.title: Pinfield
items.description: A grid of pins that carries pulses — click and a wavefront travels outward, lighting the field.

items.name: signal
items.title: Signal
items.description: A waveform you can scrub — drag horizontally to move the phase, hover to light the bars.

items.name: ripple-surface
items.title: RippleSurface
items.description: An ambient surface that ripples where you touch it — built for hero sections and invite panels.

items.name: count-up
items.title: CountUp
items.description: Numbers that count — eased value animation with tabular figures, prefixes and suffixes.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Copy to clipboard with a check-morph confirmation and a legacy fallback.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A toast system — provider, imperative API, tones, and a live region for screen readers.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Height-animated disclosure with a diamond marker that morphs between states.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Controlled or uncontrolled tabs with a sliding underline that travels between triggers.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal with focus trap, Escape handling, scroll lock and an expo entrance.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: The thread header — scroll progress with a diamond node, chapter tracking, and a full-screen mobile menu.

items.name: form-field
items.title: FormField
items.description: A label, hint and error linked to a single control without manual IDs.

items.name: text-field
items.title: TextField
items.description: A precise, labelled input with native validation and clear error feedback.

items.name: text-area
items.title: TextArea
items.description: Long-form input with resizable room for thoughts, labels and validation.

items.name: select-field
items.title: SelectField
items.description: Native selection with a Mizu-styled option menu where supported.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A generous check target with a secondary description and native form submission.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A tactile binary setting whose thumb tracks the state.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: Search with a clear action that belongs to the input.

items.name: password-field
items.title: PasswordField
items.description: A revealable secret with explicit visibility feedback.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Mutually exclusive choices with room to explain what each choice means.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: A compact selection rail for density, view and other immediate choices.

items.name: number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: A bounded numeric stepper that survives decimals and repeated actions.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating you can choose with a mouse, touch or arrow keys.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: ColorPicker
items.description: Named swatches and a native custom-color dialog, with the hex value always visible.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: TagInput
items.description: Add, remove and deduplicate tags without losing the keyboard path.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: FileDropzone
items.description: Start a file upload by dropping or browsing, with size and type validation on both paths.

items.name: async-form
items.title: AsyncForm
items.description: A form that follows the save promise and preserves input when a save fails.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A quiet diamond and a readable state, never color alone.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Contextual feedback with a title, explanation and a place to recover.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate or indeterminate progress, measured on a hairline track.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A bounded measurement that distinguishes a reading from task completion.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A restrained placeholder that retains a readable loading announcement.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: A useful absence: explain what belongs here and give the next action.

items.name: error-state
items.title: ErrorState
items.description: A failure surface that names the problem and lets the user try again.

items.name: connection-status
items.title: ConnectionStatus
items.description: A connection hint that follows actual browser online and offline events.

items.name: save-indicator
items.title: SaveIndicator
items.description: Keep the difference between saved, dirty, saving and failed visible.

items.name: async-boundary
items.title: AsyncBoundary
items.description: One readable contract for ready, loading, empty and failed content.

items.name: task-progress
items.title: TaskProgress
items.description: Make a multi-stage operation legible, including partial completion and failure.

items.name: async-button
items.title: AsyncButton
items.description: An action whose feedback follows the real promise, with duplicate clicks prevented.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: A sortable, typed table that keeps native table semantics and nulls in their place.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Aligned names and values with the semantics of a description list.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A metric with context: direction and favorability are separate decisions.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: BarChart
items.description: Readable, labelled comparisons without a charting dependency.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A compact history trace with the underlying readings in its accessible name.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: A daily activity field with every date and reading available as text.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events connected by a fine thread, with the present kept distinct.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: ActivityFeed
items.description: Filter a real event stream by its event type without losing chronological context.

items.name: diff-view
items.title: DiffView
items.description: Two text versions, aligned by line, with changes made visible.

items.name: data-inspector
items.title: DataInspector
items.description: Open a payload, follow its structure and copy the JSON without a developer-tools panel.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: TreeView
items.description: Browse a hierarchy with native disclosure and an optional selected leaf.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: ComparisonTable
items.description: A feature matrix whose rows and columns stay connected to their meaning.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A quiet path back through the hierarchy.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Move through bounded pages with a compact view of the whole sequence.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A numbered journey with a clear present step.

items.name: anchor-nav
items.title: AnchorNav
items.description: A page outline that follows the section in view.

items.name: side-nav
items.title: SideNav
items.description: Grouped destinations with the current place held in focus.

items.name: bottom-nav
items.title: BottomNav
items.description: Touch-friendly destinations that fit the phone's safe area.

items.name: action-menu
items.title: ActionMenu
items.description: A compact menu of real actions, with disabled and destructive states.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: Search commands and execute them without taking your hands off the keyboard.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Identity at a glance, with initials that survive a missing image.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard hints set apart from the surrounding sentence.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Selectable source with a real copy action and room for long lines.

items.name: quote
items.title: Quote
items.description: A serif voice in the margin, with an honest attribution.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: A readable measure for long-form documents inside an interface.

items.name: image-figure
items.title: ImageFigure
items.description: Responsive imagery with a caption and a visible failure state.

items.name: media-player
items.title: MediaPlayer
items.description: Playback handed to the browser's accessible controls.

items.name: link-card
items.title: LinkCard
items.description: A destination with enough context to decide whether to follow it.

items.name: file-card
items.title: FileCard
items.description: A downloadable resource with a legible name and size.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: Complete a set of real tasks and see how much remains.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: A single-axis layout that wraps when the task calls for it.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Responsive columns that make room for the content without breakpoint bookkeeping.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: SplitPane
items.description: Give two working regions the space they need, with a real resizable boundary.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: Reserve media space before it arrives, keeping the surrounding reading rhythm steady.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A bounded reading region that keyboard users can enter and scroll.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: Named working regions and a skip link, composed around the product's real content.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Search a bounded set of choices and select without leaving the keyboard.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: Filter a set, keep several choices and make the selection limit clear.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: InlineEdit
items.description: Change a value in place, with validation and an explicit path back.

items.name: range-selector
items.title: RangeSelector
items.description: Two bounded handles define an interval without crossing or hiding their values.

items.name: reorder-list
items.title: ReorderList
items.description: Rearrange a sequence while each item keeps its identity.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: ImageCompare
items.description: Reveal two versions with a divider that follows your hand.

items.name: history-controls
items.title: HistoryControls
items.description: Undo and redo a bounded edit history, including the branch created by a new change.

items.name: confirm-action
items.title: ConfirmAction
items.description: Review a consequential action, execute the actual promise and recover from failure.

items.name: motion-preferences
items.title: MotionPreferences
items.description: An explicit motion preference for everything inside it — Motion, CSS and canvas — or the operating system’s when omitted.

items.name: fonts
items.title: Fonts
items.description: Mizu’s three faces, self-hosted: Archivo with its width axis, Instrument Serif and JetBrains Mono.
items.docs: Import mizu/fonts.css from your UI directory once, in your root layout. To use next/font instead, see https://github.com/0xuser64bit/mizu#fonts

items.name: preset
items.title: Mizu preset
items.description: Sets up components.json for Mizu without shadcn’s theme, leaving your global CSS as it is, and adds Mizu’s tokens and fonts.
items.docs: Import mizu/fonts.css from your UI directory once, in your root layout. To use next/font instead, see https://github.com/0xuser64bit/mizu#fonts
